name: Braintree
tagline: PayPal-owned payment platform for cards, wallets, and merchant accounts
description: Braintree is a full-stack payments platform (PayPal) for accepting cards, PayPal, Venmo, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and more. Merchants use server SDKs or GraphQL to create customers, vault payment methods, authorize/capture transactions, and manage refunds. Access requires a merchant account; credentials are public key, private key, and merchant ID (or GraphQL access tokens).
base_url: https://api.braintreegateway.com (prod REST); sandbox REST https://api.sandbox.braintreegateway.com; GraphQL https://payments.braintree-api.com/graphql (sandbox: https://payments.sandbox.braintree-api.com/graphql)

auth.details: Server SDKs: public key, private key, and merchant ID (Basic auth style). GraphQL: Bearer access token. Sandbox and production use separate credentials and hosts.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Sandbox free for full API testing; no free production transaction quota. US standard cards 2.89%+$0.29 (as of May 2026); rates vary by region/method — confirm official pricing

example.request: curl -X POST https://payments.sandbox.braintree-api.com/graphql -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Braintree-Version: 2024-08-01" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"query { ping }"}'

use_cases: create a payment transaction from a client nonce
vault a customer's card for recurring charges
refund or void a prior Braintree transaction
generate a client token for Drop-in UI
look up a transaction by ID
create a customer and store a payment method
